notes: 02: server extractMetadata/client collect only title, description, favicon; no preview image (og:image) is collected or shown. 04: url/title/description/tags editable in BookmarkModal, but there is no note field at all. 06: saveBookmark for new items always creates a fresh id via Date.now() with no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. 10: tags entered as a plain comma-separated text input; no existing-tag autocomplete. 12: search haystack covers title, domain, description, tags but not full url (only domain) and there is no note field to search. 14: search is plain substring over lowercased haystack; '#tag' would not match tags stored without '#'. 15: no boolean AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing, only substring includes. 16: no quoted-phrase parsing; quotes are treated as literal characters. 20: no multi-select UI or bulk actions. 21: no filter-scoped bulk apply. 23: no note/markdown field or rendering. 24: no local HTML snapshot or PDF handling. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26: no archive flag/state (only favorite, readLater, collections). 27: only delete exists; no reversible archive. 28: no archived-only list. 29: collections are manual buckets, not saved search-term + included/excluded-tag filters (bundles). 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: sort dropdown and grid/list toggle exist as ephemeral session controls, but no persisted personal settings profile (default sort, displayed items, font size); font size unsupported.
